name: Opt-in clocks and placeholder weather/urban noise
registered_before: Any new-physics golden generation or benchmark outcomes
default: Absent/zero new settings are OFF; existing DEFAULT_SETTINGS and frozen site JSON must not change.

physics.clock: t_local=(1+drift_ppm*1e-6)*t_global+offset_ms/1000; common linear resampling for every mic in a node; independent seeded per-node Gaussian offset/drift. No inter-node TDOA constraint is claimed.
physics.wind: Placeholder 140 Hz low-pass Gaussian turbulence; RMS 55 dB SPL at 5 m/s, pressure proportional to speed squared; square-root power mixture of shared-node and private-mic noise. No aerodynamic validation.
physics.urban: Placeholder additive low-pass 250 Hz Gaussian noise plus a 75 Hz tone (20% amplitude), rescaled to declared RMS; not a recorded city noise model.
physics.rain: Placeholder broadband Gaussian plus sparse exponentially decaying impacts, rescaled to declared RMS; no housing response or rainfall-rate calibration.
physics.time_variation: Two shared-node slow sinusoidal amplitude envelopes with declared peak dB depth, deterministic phases. Existing source signals are not modulated.

unit_population.checks: Exact byte hashes, repeat equality, clock ramp/impulse against analytic mapping, identical wind at correlation=1, declared RMS and spectrum checks, all old signal goldens untouched.

analysis: Complete equal scene/seed populations for each profile; report all metrics and nulls, never a hardware winner. New physics is opt-in and not an accepted algorithm improvement. Default-off legacy smoke must pass rule four. The new sealed study retains only its already frozen original physics population.
